So the update for the voice tool is that Phonon now runs speech recognition entirely on the laptop and only sends text to the cloud for cleanup. We tested it on three laptops. The first laptop had a slower microphone, so the transcripts had more errors, but the cleanup still fixed most of the punctuation. The biggest issue was the cloud model adding words nobody spoke, so the prompt now says to keep the wording and only fix the formatting. The work in progress branch has that change. The final checkpoint is on friday.
